claims.claim: Use plain Rails with Hotwire; it's enough for 40 users
claims.measured: ruby-rails on 1 CPU: 3,704 req/s plaintext, 2,505 req/s with one Postgres query (p99 36 ms), 557 req/s with 20 queries per request (p99 133 ms)
claims.why: Even the heaviest measured Rails workload handles hundreds of requests per second on one core, far more than 40 internal users would generate.
